plays.desc_en: At level 1, Curse (Qiyana) wards Inspired's raptor camp while LOS places defensive wards around bot, a ward the casters later credit for revealing Inspired's topside pathing.
plays.quote: So Curse does get the raptor ward down ... here on Inspired's Raptors ... they also have defensive warding around

plays.desc_en: Duduhh (Caitlyn) and Ackerman (Karma) push LYON's bot duo off the wave and focus Isles (Lulu) in a trade the casters call very good, though Isles dodges Inner Flame with movement and heal, and Piltover Peacemaker misses Berserker.
plays.quote: pinser right here to push them away from ... they're going to focus fire Isles here. ... Very good trade so far. Nice juke

plays.desc_ko: Curse가 3캠프 정글링 후 귀환하여 Kiana용 롱소드를 추가 구매하고, 다시 나와 탑 쪽을 정리하면서 롱소드로 바위게 경합을 노림.
plays.desc_en: Curse (Qiyana) clears three camps, recalls for an extra Long Sword, then heads back out to clear topside and contest the Scuttle Crab.
plays.quote: we did have Curse just do the three camp ... recall clear for the extra long sword on ... sword look to contest the scuttle crab.

plays.desc_ko: Inspired는 일반적인 정글링으로 맵 상단(탑 쪽)으로 이동. 해설은 레벨 1 칼날부리 와드 때문에 LOS가 이 동선을 알고 있었다고 덧붙임.
plays.desc_en: Inspired (Lee Sin) paths normally toward the top side, a route the casters note LOS knew about thanks to the level 1 raptor ward.
plays.quote: Uh whereas Inspired has just continued ... on a normal clear up towards top side of

plays.quote: they are free and the push from Doo and ... Acrian is taking its toll and it forced ... the Berserker back already.

plays.desc_en: Berserker (Yunara) and Isles (Lulu) step up aggressively, pushing back Ackerman and Duduhh; they burn Ackerman's Heal but Isles uses hers too, leaving summoners even and LOS very low.
plays.quote: for the 2v2 here in the bottom lane. ... Acan and Doodoo backing up as Berserker ... and Isles posture aggressively.

plays.desc_ko: Curse가 미드에서 Saint(Orianna)를 노리고 갱킹. Saint가 사슬(Leblanc E로 추정)을 옆으로 피하고 Kiana의 Q 두 개도 모두 피하며 후속 포킹 피해까지 회피.

plays.quote: looking for a gank. ... Saint's going to be your target. ... Does sidestep the chain.

plays.desc_ko: 미드에서 회피전이 벌어지는 동안 LYON이 첫 번째 드래곤을 획득.
plays.desc_en: While the mid skirmish plays out, LYON takes the first dragon.
plays.quote: will take the objective during all of ... early drake number one here for Lion ... addition to the early dragon that they

plays.desc_en: Around the same time, LYON's pressured bot lane pulls the wave to bounce it back and narrow the CS gap.
plays.quote: to pull the wave bottom lane as well to ... they can try and even up their CS on

plays.desc_ko: Dhokla가 메가 나르로 Zest(Ambessa)와 공격적으로 교환, 벽 근처에서 바위 던지기로 낮은 체력의 Zest에게 점멸을 강제. 추격은 이어졌지만 점멸로 Zest가 생존.
plays.desc_en: Dhokla (Gnar) trades aggressively as Mega Gnar and uses Boulder Toss near a wall to force Flash from a low Zest (Ambessa), who survives the chase.
plays.quote: Los Da just using the megaard to trade ... very aggressively into Zest. ... WITH THE BOULDER TOSS FORCES FLASH ON

plays.desc_en: Curse and Feisty roam to catch Saint (Orianna) in the jungle, but Curse's ultimate hits a wall to little effect and he is targeted after Saint's Shockwave, dying for LYON's First Blood.
plays.quote: and Los is aiming at the bottom lane. ... the jungle as Curse throws out the ulti ... just into the wall.

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 정글에서 스킬을 피한 뒤 충격파로 받아치고 Inspired가 바로 뒤에서 합류해 Curse를 처치, 퍼스트 블러드를 획득. Saint는 이후 감정표현까지 함.
plays.desc_en: Saint (Orianna) dodges the skills and answers with Command: Shockwave as Inspired (Lee Sin) follows up to kill Curse for First Blood, with Saint emoting afterward.

plays.desc_en: Inspired (Lee Sin) is interrupted on Void Grubs and, without a second Smite charge, gives up on taking both; casters note a 2-1 grub split isn't a big gap.
plays.quote: Gets a little interrupt. ... Inspire doesn't have another charge of ... his smite back up yet.

plays.desc_ko: LOS 바텀 듀오가 탑으로 올라가는 라인 스왑을 실행해 Dhokla를 Caitlyn-Karma의 원거리 견제로 압박. Dhokla는 메가 나르로 변신해 거리를 벌림; Berserker는 바텀에 홀로 남고 Zest가 그 상대로 감. 이후 Dhokla는 탑에서 미니언을 먹지 못하고 밀려남(LYON은 반대편에서 같은 압박을 하지 못함).

plays.quote: continues to do a good job s sideest ... stepping these chains from the Leblanc

plays.quote: the minar cautiously approaching knows ... ward into the brush spots curse.

plays.desc_en: Ackerman (Karma)'s pressure forces Berserker (Yunara) to use her ultimate defensively, and out of mana she heads back.

plays.desc_en: Berserker breaks Ackerman's tether but Inner Flame drops him to 200; Curse joins, Inspired comes to help, and Duduhh (Caitlyn) finishes Berserker with headshots before he can use summoners, though nothing follows objective-wise.
plays.quote: Acan cast the tether, but ... Curse ... wants to go in.

plays.quote: goes in for the solo kill potential onto ... He just has to poke him down a ... warning shot.

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 충격파(Orianna R)로 Curse에게 큰 피해를 줘 Kiana를 25%까지 떨어뜨리며 LOS의 바론 시도를 저지.

plays.desc_en: As LOS starts Baron, Saint (Orianna) tries to get something at the bot tier 2 turret.
plays.quote: just trying to get whatever he can down ... here from the bottom lane tier two as

plays.desc_ko: LOS가 바론을 시작했고 LYON은 '이 바론 싸움은 이길 수 없다'며 접근하지 않음(Infinity Edge와 Inspired의 Guardian Angel 전에는 싸우지 않는 콜). LOS가 바론 획득.
plays.desc_en: LYON declines to contest, calling the fight unwinnable before Infinity Edge and Inspired's Guardian Angel, and LOS takes Baron.
plays.quote: the Baron is started up by Los. ... Instead, Baron to Los 27 minutes into ... They've got the Red Bull Baron power

plays.desc_ko: 바론 버프를 두른 LOS가 바텀 3차(억제기) 포탑을 공성; Caitlyn의 큰 한 방이 Berserker를 절반으로 깎음. Zest는 탑 웨이브를 정리하고, Saint는 반대편에서 무언가를 얻으려 함.
plays.desc_en: Baron-buffed LOS sieges the bot inhibitor turret as a big Caitlyn shot halves Berserker, Zest clears top, and Saint looks for something elsewhere.
plays.quote: Los are sieging the bottom lane tier ... three turret. There was one big hit on ... as Zest clears out the wave

plays.desc_ko: LOS가 탑에서 Saint에게 다이브; Isles의 Wild Growth로 Saint는 보호받지만 LOS는 탑 2차 포탑을 밀어붙임. Dhokla는 메가 나르로 변신했지만 게이지가 끝나감. Feisty는 팀과 떨어져 사이드에 있음.
plays.desc_en: LOS dives Saint top; Isles' Wild Growth saves him but LOS pushes the tier 2 turret while Dhokla's Mega form runs out and Feisty sits on a sidelane.
plays.quote: SAINTS PRESENT IS A DIVE COMING IN FROM ... LOS. He gets the wild growth from Isles ... bulldozing through the tier 2 turret

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤 스폰 직전 LYON이 상단 강가 바론 쪽으로 이동해 LOS를 끌어들임. Zest가 진입했지만 Berserker가 수풀에서 대기; Dhokla는 Feisty를 쫓다 메가 나르 변신 실패, Curse가 벽 너머로 Dhokla에게 피해. Berserker가 계속 사격해 Duduhh를 처치(큰 현상금). Inspired가 후방으로 더 파고들었지만 Guardian Angel만 소모. Berserker는 Feisty의 마지막 스킬을 피해 생존, '1대0'이지만 그 이상은 얻지 못함.
plays.desc_en: LYON baits LOS near Baron; Zest engages into a waiting Berserker (Yunara), who keeps firing to kill a high-bounty Duduhh, while Inspired burns Guardian Angel diving and Berserker dodges Feisty's last skill for a 1-0 trade.
plays.quote: towards the baron instead. ... Zest jumps in. ... Berserker's already in the brush waiting

plays.desc_ko: 교전 이후에도 드래곤은 LOS가 획득해 LYON의 드래곤 영혼을 다시 막음.
plays.desc_en: After the fight, LOS still takes the dragon, denying LYON's soul again.
plays.quote: GOING TO BE DRAKE OVER TO LOS. ... Los got the dragon

plays.desc_ko: LOS가 리셋하고 드래곤을 챙긴 뒤 LYON이 바론을 시작; LOS가 저지하러 오면서 교전이 벌어지고, 바론이 절반 남은 상태에서 Duduhh가 부활해 합류하자 LYON이 물러남.
plays.desc_en: LYON starts Baron after LOS resets, a fight breaks out, and LYON backs off with Baron at half once Duduhh respawns and joins.
plays.quote: coming back to stop the baron. The baron ... started up by Lion. ... The Baron STILL ABOUT HALF HP. Lion

plays.desc_ko: LOS가 바론 저지에 나서 Zest의 텔레포트가 합류하는 순간 LYON 한 명이 즉사. 이어 Feisty가 다시 앞으로 나와 폭딜을 넣고, Zest의 공개 처형이 맞았다면 한 명 더 잡을 뻔했지만 LYON은 버팀. 연장 교전에서 Curse는 사망.
plays.desc_en: Zest's Teleport arrives and a LYON member dies instantly; Feisty bursts again and Zest's Public Execution nearly nets another, but LYON holds and Curse dies in the extended fight.
plays.quote: A teleport coming ... OVER FROM ZAS AS DIES INSTANTLY. ... INSTANT DEATH FROM LOWE'S.

plays.desc_ko: LOS 합류 후 LYON이 Berserker를 중심으로 반격해 현상금(셧다운)을 되찾고, 연장 교전에서 Curse를 처치.
plays.desc_en: LYON counterattacks around Berserker (Yunara), reclaiming a shutdown and killing Curse in the extended fight.
plays.quote: GET THE SHUTDOWN BACK THANKS TO ... BERSERKER WITH CURSE into the picture. ... killed Curse in the extended fight.

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 물러난 뒤 바론은 LOS의 것이 됨; Dhokla가 텔레포트로 들어왔지만 LYON은 주요 소환사 주문만 잃음. 이후 LOS는 바론 버프를 두른 대포 미니언으로 공성.
plays.desc_en: With LYON gone, LOS takes Baron as Dhokla's Teleport only costs LYON key summoners, and LOS sieges with empowered cannons.
plays.quote: They're just backing away for now. ... baron belongs to Los. But the teleport ... the objective.

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 드디어 미드 1차 포탑을 확보하고 더 밀고 올라감.
plays.desc_en: LYON finally takes the mid tier 1 turret and pushes further.
plays.quote: Lion will finally secure the mid ... lane tier one turret.

plays.desc_ko: 포탑 이후 LYON이 게임을 어지럽히려 공격적으로 나섬; 그 과정에서 Dhokla가 체력 절반을 잃고, Curse는 약간 맞았지만 LYON 누구도 따라잡아 압박하지 못함. LOS는 침착함을 유지.
plays.desc_en: LYON plays aggressively to create chaos, but Dhokla loses half his health and nobody can follow up on a lightly hit Curse as LOS stays composed.
plays.quote: Trying to make this game messy. ... loses half HP. ... of damage, but nobody on Lion can catch

plays.desc_ko: LOS가 LYON 기지 입구에서 공성; Dhokla의 메가 나르가 끝나 지칠 때를 노리며 바론 버프 대포 미니언으로 방어선을 서서히 깎음.
plays.desc_en: LOS sieges LYON's base entrance, waiting out Dhokla's Mega form while Baron-empowered cannons chip the defenses.
plays.quote: Currently Los at the base at their gates ... trying to siege.

plays.desc_ko: Saint는 걸어오는 대신 텔레포트로 합류, LYON이 바텀 알코브 쪽에 결집. Dhokla의 부메랑은 빗나가고 Inspired는 Zest만 찾고 과진입하지 않음. 이후 교전에서 Berserker가 킬을 따내고 Curse가 쓰러지며, Inspired가 셧다운을 챙기고 Berserker가 더블킬. LOS 세 명 사망. Berserker는 Leblanc의 사슬과 폭딜을 모두 피함(리플레이: 탑 쪽에서 Leblanc/Kiana를 피해 점멸로 생존, Saint도 벽 너머에서 생존).
plays.desc_en: Saint Teleports in as LYON groups bot; Dhokla's boomerang misses, Inspired avoids overcommitting, and Berserker (Yunara) dodges LeBlanc's chain and burst, Flashing to survive and taking a double kill as Inspired claims a shutdown and three LOS fall.
plays.quote: teleport instead. ... Lion grouping up together ... only finds Zest does not want to

plays.desc_ko: 확정 산악 영혼이 걸린 드래곤에서 LOS가 둥지를 장악하고 Caitlyn 덫으로 강가에 벽을 세우며, 메가 나르 시간을 인내심 있게 기다림. Feisty가 먼저 진입했지만 폭딜이 빗나가고, 텔레포트로 다시 합류해 Berserker를 노렸지만 큰 피해를 주지 못함. 결과적으로 LOS는 세 명을 잃음.
plays.desc_en: LOS controls the Mountain Soul pit with Caitlyn traps walling the river and waits out Mega Gnar; Feisty's burst misses on entry and his Teleport flank on Berserker does little, costing LOS three members.
plays.quote: dragon's rage, but it's Los with control ... Feisty jumps in, but his burst ... does not land.

plays.desc_ko: 교전 승리 후 LYON이 마지막 순간 드래곤(산악 영혼)을 획득.
plays.desc_en: After winning the fight, LYON takes the Mountain Soul dragon at the last moment.
plays.quote: THE DRAGON SOUL WILL GO TO LION. ... LION WILL CLAIM THE SOUL. ... Lion with a mountain soul

plays.desc_ko: 5대2 상황에서 LYON이 바텀으로 진군해 첫 번째 3차 포탑과 억제기를 연달아 파괴. LOS 부활 시간 때문에 게임을 끝내지는 못하고, 이후 리셋이 필요해짐.
plays.desc_en: Up 5v2, LYON pushes bot and takes an inner turret and inhibitor, but LOS respawns prevent an end and LYON must reset.
plays.quote: LION MARCHING DOWN BOTTOM LANE NOW WITH ... A FIVE V2 ON THE MAP. ... the first tier three turret.

plays.desc_ko: LYON의 공성 중 Feisty가 진입했지만 Berserker는 보호받음. 이후에도 Feisty가 LYON의 관심을 끌며 귀환을 늦추려 했지만 진입 과정에서 피해를 입음.
plays.desc_en: Feisty (LeBlanc) dives in but Berserker is protected; he keeps drawing attention to delay LYON's back but takes damage doing it.
plays.quote: IN, BUT BERSERKER IS PROTECTED. ... Feisty trying to keep them interested. ... Yeah, but Feisty does take some damage

plays.desc_ko: LOS가 바론 둥지로 들어가 바론을 시작, Zest가 피해를 받아냄. 바론은 빠르게 깎였지만 LYON의 진입으로 중단되고 바론은 그대로 남음.
plays.desc_en: LOS starts Baron with Zest (Ambessa) tanking, but LYON's engage interrupts and Baron survives.
plays.quote: to the Baron. ... Los into the Baron pitch starting this ... Zest soaking the damage from it.

plays.desc_ko: Dhokla가 벽을 넘어 메가 나르로 진입, Inspired도 압박. Feisty가 들어왔다가 큰 피해를 입고 빠지려다 사망(LYON이 미드라이너를 잡음). LYON은 Zest와 Duduhh를 계속 추격했지만 과하게 쫓다 역공을 맞음. 이후 Berserker는 바론을 치며 LOS를 유인.
plays.desc_en: Dhokla (Gnar) jumps the wall as Mega Gnar and Inspired presses; Feisty dies trying to escape, but LYON overchases Zest and Duduhh and gets punished, after which Berserker hits Baron to bait LOS.
plays.quote: Do jumps in ... LION ON PURSUIT. ... FEISTY IS ALREADY DOWN. LION HAVE FOUND

plays.desc_ko: Feisty를 잃은 뒤 Zest와 Duduhh가 LYON 정글 쪽으로 빠지면서 역공; Dhokla의 벽이 Duduhh를 잡지 못하고, Duduhh의 Ace in the Hole로 Saint 처치. LOS가 두 명을 잡아 3대3이 됨. Zest는 슈퍼 미니언으로부터 넥서스 포탑을 지키러 복귀하고, 투시 트링킷으로 Inspired의 위치를 확인. 해설은 협공(핀서)으로 시간을 더 벌었다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: Zest and Duduhh counter through LYON's jungle; Dhokla's wall misses and Duduhh's Ace in the Hole kills Saint, evening it 3v3, while Zest defends the Nexus turret and scans Inspired, buying time.
plays.quote: ZAST AND DOO both trying to get ... THE ACE IN THE HOLE AND ... HE'S SHOT DOWN. LOS FIGHT BACK. THEY

plays.desc_ko: 45분 경 바론 구도에서 LOS가 Leblanc을 바텀으로 보내 슈퍼 미니언을 처리.
plays.desc_en: Around 45 minutes, LOS sends Feisty (LeBlanc) bot to clear super minions.
plays.quote: They're sending Lilanc back to bottom ... lane to deal with the super minions.

plays.desc_ko: Berserker가 미드 입구 포탑(3차)을 치며 LOS에게 선택을 강요; Curse가 옆에 있지만 Berserker와 Isles가 포탑을 거의 부수고 미니언이 마무리. LYON이 미드 3차 포탑을 '공짜로' 획득.
plays.desc_en: Berserker (Yunara) and Isles (Lulu) nearly destroy the mid inhibitor turret despite Curse nearby, and minions finish it for LYON for free.
plays.quote: is at the mid lane. Berserker is at the ... HE'S TAKING THE TOWER. ... FORCING LOS TO MAKE A CHOICE.

plays.desc_ko: Berserker와 Isles가 미드 포탑을 거의 부수는 사이 LOS가 바론을 시작했지만, 나머지 LOS가 바론에서 물러나 재정비하며 바론을 내줌.
plays.desc_en: LOS starts Baron while the mid turret falls, but the rest of LOS backs off to regroup and concedes it.
plays.quote: Baron's going to get started up by Los ... while the rest of Los also has to back ... away from the Baron.

plays.desc_ko: LOS가 물러난 뒤 LYON이 바론 둥지를 장악하고 바론을 획득.
plays.desc_en: After LOS withdraws, LYON takes the pit and secures Baron.
plays.quote: control over the Baron pit. ... takes Baron. ... They have Baron.

plays.desc_ko: LOS가 장로 드래곤 주변에 방어용 덫과 포지션을 깔고, LYON이 미드로 돌진하는 동안 장로 드래곤을 처치하려 함; 해설상 장로는 곧 쓰러질 상황이었으나 획득 여부는 불명확.
plays.desc_en: LOS sets traps around Elder and tries to take it while LYON charges mid; it was close to falling, though whether LOS secured it is unclear.
plays.quote: already setting up defensive traps and ... positioning around the Elder Drake. ... as Lo tries to take the yellow dragon.

plays.desc_ko: 바론 버프를 가진 LYON이 장로 스폰 직전 미드로 돌진해 넥서스를 압박하는 '대담한 도박'. Berserker가 Zest를 둔화시키며 추격해 Ambessa의 Guardian Angel을 벗겨내고, Zest는 공개 처형으로 반격하려 했지만 이미 사망. LYON이 기지 안으로 들어가 넥서스로 향하며 경기를 끝내는 콜을 성공. 다음 경기 소개에서 LYON 승리로 3세트가 열렸다고 회고.
plays.desc_en: With Baron, LYON boldly charges mid just before Elder; Berserker (Yunara) slows and strips Zest's Guardian Angel, Zest dies before his Public Execution counter lands, and LYON drives to the Nexus to win and force game three.
plays.quote: Our Lion just going to rush down mid ... to put the pressure on the enemy nexus. ... GAMBIT COMING IN FROM LION. ZEST SLOWED

plays.desc_ko: LYON 본대가 미드를 압박하는 동안 Inspired가 장로 드래곤 스틸을 위협하고 LOS의 복귀를 막으려 함(자막 혼선).
plays.desc_en: While LYON's main force pressures mid, Inspired (Lee Sin) threatens an Elder steal and tries to block LOS's return.
plays.quote: the mid pressure here while Inspired ... threatens the steal. ... GETTING BACK THE KICK TO INSPIRED STOP
